{{#ifexist:{{{2|{{DF:Current}}}}}:{{{1}}}/raw|1|0}}<noinclude>

A boolean used to determine if a creature exists.

Usage:
<pre>{{creature/exists|name|namespace={{DF:Current}}}}</pre>

<pre>{{creature/exists|Aardvark}}</pre>
Returns {{creature/exists|Aardvark}}
 
<pre>{{creature/exists|Clown}}</pre>
Returns {{creature/exists|Clown}}
[[Category:Creature macros]]</noinclude>
